## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] New resource
- [ ] Resource metadata update
- [ ] Site or documentation change
- [ ] Validation or workflow change

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run validate` and it passes.
- [ ] New files are inside `resources/<category-id>/<resource-id>/` and match the paths in `data/resources.json`.
- [ ] The resource has accurate team, season, category, attribution, and license metadata.
- [ ] The resource does not contain secrets, private student information, or material I do not have permission to publish.
- [ ] External links use stable public http(s) URLs.
